_comment: Root ESG term lexicon for the morphological-masking (T-603) and terminology-gap (T-604) diagnostic modules. Curated by hand in Hindi only -- the one language this project's owner can verify -- per CLAUDE4.md's morphological masking design and the plan approved for Phase 6. `ben`/`tel`/`mal` are populated mechanically by `scripts/t603_esg_terms.py`, which calls the same frozen IndicTrans2 model used to build the corpus, and are documented as machine-derived rather than human-verified. Until that script is run (it needs the gated `ai4bharat/indictrans2-indic-indic-1B` weights and HF auth per CLAUDE.md 3.1, unavailable in this build environment), those fields are null and the diagnostics modules skip any concept whose target-language form is missing for the language in question -- never fabricated.
